result.title: From Joint Risk to Decision Invariance: Decision-Preserving Regularization for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
result.summary: Exemplar-free continual learning seeks to minimize joint risk over all seen tasks, yet historical data are unavailable for direct optimization. We observe that, for classification, preserving the model's decisions on previously learned classes helps retain old knowledge. This motivates Decision-Preserving Regularization (DPR). Penalizing changes in all pairwise old-class logit margins reduces algebraically to a centered relative-logit penalty. We further apply spectral whitening to remove the classifier's spectral scale bias. Because the global classifier supplies the decision constraints for the next stage, it must remain calibrated across all seen classes despite the drift of stored old-class statistics during representation updates. We therefore fit a closed-form affine map from paired current-task features to transport old-class Gaussian means and covariances into the updated feature space, then calibrate the global classifier using these distributions and current-task features. Across CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet-Subset, and ImageNet-1K under cold-start protocols, comparisons with state-of-the-art methods show that DPR achieves higher accuracy in most settings while remaining highly efficient. Code is available at https://github.com/bnufw/dpr.

AI.brief_summary: 针对无样本类增量学习，提出决策保持正则（惩罚旧类成对 logit margin 变化，等价于中心化相对 logit 惩罚），并用闭式仿射映射把旧类高斯均值与协方差搬运到更新后的特征空间以校准全局分类器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其分布搬运与谱白化去尺度偏置的做法，可能为表征更新后 latent 状态的一致性维持与相似度度量中的尺度、漂移影响提供可供核查的线索，但并非直接研究 VLM 推理。
